headline: Ferrari Expands Sales Push Targeting India's Growing Billionaire Wealth
summary: Ferrari is expanding its dealer footprint in secondary Indian cities after registering only 45 vehicle sales in the country last year, targeting a demographic of 391 local billionaires.
why: Luxury goods and high-performance automotive manufacturers are pivoting sales strategies toward rapidly expanding high-net-worth individual populations in emerging Asian economies.
